    (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
     FROM `molecule`) AS total;

    WHERE q.raceId = 355
    AND (q.q2 LIKE '%01:40%' OR q.q2 LIKE '%1:40%' OR q.q2 LIKE '%00:01:40%')
),
t_nationality AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.nationality
    FROM fuzzy_q2_with_race f
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON f.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT nationality
FROM t_nationality;
